cards.title: Experimental settings turn on chat view, its default, and the structured runtime
cards.user_does: Opens the Experimental settings section and flips the Chat UI switch, then optionally picks a default view and the structured runtime opt-in.
cards.user_sees: One master switch that lists the supported agents; once on, a Default view select (Terminal chat or Chat UI) appears; once the default is Chat UI, a third switch opts into the updated structured chat, with a note that it is local-only.
rules: All three values default off; the master switch only affects newly created supported local sessions, existing terminals keep terminal chat.
The default-view select is shown only while the master switch is on; the structured opt-in only while the default is Chat UI.
Hiding a nested control never clears its stored value; it comes back when the parent is turned on again.
Structured scope copy: WSL and remote/SSH hosts keep terminal chat, and Windows falls back unless process start times are readable.
The Experimental section is folded in the rebuild, so these become build-time choices rather than user switches.
acceptance: Fresh profile → all three keys read false and only the master switch is visible.
Turn master on → select appears with Terminal chat chosen; choose Chat UI → structured switch appears off.
Turn structured on, set default back to Terminal chat, then Chat UI again → structured switch still on.
cards.compat: settings keys experimentalNativeChat, openAgentTabsInChatByDefault, experimentalStructuredNativeChat (all boolean, default false)
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Which sessions can be shown as chat
cards.user_does: Opens an agent session in the Agents view, or tries to switch a terminal tab to chat.
cards.user_sees: Chat is offered only for supported agent sessions; everything else stays a plain terminal.
rules: Supported agents: Claude, OpenClaude (read as Claude format), Codex, Grok and omp; shells, editors, browser tabs and other agents are refused.
The agent detected live in the pane wins over a stale tab title or the launch hint; a title alone never opens chat for an unsupported agent.
A session whose transcript the host cannot read locally (an SSH host without a reader) stays terminal.
The Agents view allows chat even when the experimental flag is off; the Terminals tab requires the flag.
A tab already in chat can always switch back to terminal, even if support was lost.
Structured sessions show no terminal/chat switcher.
A pending (still launching) session shows a chooser in the Agents view, not chat.
acceptance: Run Claude in a pane → chat is available; run a plain shell → it is not.
Rename an unsupported agent tab to look like Claude → chat is still not offered.
With the flag off, the Agents view still renders a Codex session as chat.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Switch a tab between chat and terminal with a shortcut
cards.user_does: Presses Cmd+Shift+J (Ctrl+Shift+J off Mac) in a supported agent tab, or picks the switch-to-terminal menu item.
cards.user_sees: The focused pane flips between the raw terminal and the chat view of the same session; the choice sticks to that tab across restarts.
rules: The shortcut acts on the active split leaf; title-based detection is only used for single-pane layouts.
Adding Alt to the chord does not trigger it.
The per-tab view mode is saved with the session; tabs saved before the feature open as terminal.
The terminal process is never restarted by a switch; chat reads the same session.
acceptance: Press the chord twice in a Claude tab → chat then terminal, same process id.
Restart the app with a tab in chat → it reopens in chat.
Alt+Ctrl+Shift+J → nothing happens.
cards.compat: hardcoded chord Mod+Shift+J (no keybinding id); tab viewMode field in the saved session file
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Right-click menu inside the chat view
cards.user_does: Right-clicks in the chat transcript or composer.
cards.user_sees: A pane menu with copy and paste, a switch back to terminal, continue or fork the session, split right or down, equalize, collapse or expand, set title, copy session/terminal/pane ids, and close pane.
rules: Split actions reuse the terminal pane split path for bridge chat and the workspace-tab move path for structured chat.
Copy uses the current selection; Paste goes into the composer.
In structured chat the menu offers workspace layout actions only, without terminal-only pane commands.
acceptance: Right-click in chat → the switch-to-terminal item flips the pane to terminal.
Pick split right → a new pane opens beside the chat pane.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: New agent tabs can open straight into chat
cards.user_does: With the default view set to Chat UI, launches a supported agent.
cards.user_sees: The new tab opens in chat instead of the terminal, with the launch preferences (model, effort) applied.
rules: Needs the master flag, the chat default and a supported agent; otherwise the tab opens as terminal.
A launch whose prompt cannot be mirrored still opens in chat only when the draft is mirrorable.
A remote host whose transcript is not locally readable forces terminal.
Launch session options are applied only when the tab actually resolves to chat.
acceptance: Default = Chat UI, launch Codex → tab opens in chat.
Default = Terminal chat → same launch opens as terminal.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Chat follows the agent transcript live, even before it exists on disk
cards.user_does: Opens chat for a session that just started or is mid-conversation.
cards.user_sees: A loading state, then the conversation, then new turns appear as the agent writes them; a brand-new session never flashes an error while its transcript is still unwritten.
rules: First read is a snapshot, then only appended lines stream in.
A transcript that does not exist yet keeps the view loading and retries with backoff (1, 2, 4, 8 s, then every 10 s) for up to 60 s before showing an error.
File rotation, rename or recreation re-binds the watcher; a polling fallback covers missed file events.
The transcript path reported by the agent hook is preferred over a directory scan.
Empty conversations show an empty state; a known working session before flush stays loading but keeps Stop available.
A half-written last transcript line is held back until it is complete.
acceptance: Open chat on a session whose transcript file appears 5 s later → loading, then messages, never an error.
Delete and recreate the transcript → chat keeps updating.
No transcript for 70 s → readable error state.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Where each agent transcript is found and how it is decoded
cards.user_does: Runs Claude, OpenClaude, Codex, Grok or omp with custom or default home folders.
cards.user_sees: The right conversation appears in chat regardless of which account home the agent used.
rules: Claude: the configured Claude config dir first, then the default home; OpenClaude uses the Claude layout.
Codex: the Kolux-managed account home first, then the Codex home variable.
Grok and omp: their own home variables; Grok wrapper tags and bootstrap rows are stripped; reasoning summaries kept.
Each provider format decoder drops system prompts and control bytes and restores pasted-image companions.
Turn start and end are derived from the transcript so a crashed turn does not stay working forever.
acceptance: Set a custom Claude config dir, run Claude → chat shows that session.
Grok transcript with wrapped user text → chat shows only the user words.
cards.compat: env vars CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, GROK_HOME, OMP_CODING_AGENT_DIR; transcript formats Claude JSONL, Codex rollout, Grok chat history, omp
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Long conversations load in pages
cards.user_does: Scrolls to the top of a long chat and presses the load-earlier control.
cards.user_sees: The most recent 300 messages at first; each press of Load earlier messages adds 200 older ones until the start is reached and the control goes away.
rules: Loading older pages keeps the reading position.
A hide/reveal during a page load does not mix pages from the old stream.
Structured chat restores a recent window on open and fetches older history page by page on demand; a late older page never rewinds newer live content.
acceptance: 1,000-message transcript → 300 shown; press twice → 700 shown; press until start → control gone.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Hidden chats stop reading and keep their last good view
cards.user_does: Switches away from a chat, comes back, or loses the terminal connection briefly.
cards.user_sees: Coming back shows the conversation immediately and catches up; a reconnect keeps the open composer and draft; a read error after content was shown keeps the content instead of a full-pane error.
rules: A chat that starts hidden does no transcript reads; hiding unsubscribes and cancels pending retries.
Revealing opens one fresh stream whose snapshot replaces anything stale.
Retained messages are dropped if the session identity changed while hidden.
A full-pane error is shown only when nothing was retained.
acceptance: Hide a chat for a minute while the agent works, reveal → new turns appear with no duplicates.
Kill the PTY link and restore it → composer text is still there.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Messages appear once, in order, without system noise
cards.user_does: Reads the conversation.
cards.user_sees: User and agent turns in time order with hover timestamps and a per-message copy button; internal reminders and task notices are hidden; an interrupted turn shows a single status row.
rules: Messages from the hook feed, the transcript and terminal scrape are merged; the transcript copy wins and duplicates are dropped.
Ordering is by timestamp then id; a streaming preview sorts after real content but before not-yet-confirmed sends.
System reminders, task notifications and other injected envelopes are hidden; a skill or slash envelope shows as the token the user typed.
Image markers in text are merged into an image turn with a thumbnail and full-size view.
Copy message shows a short Copied confirmation; timestamps follow the UI language.
acceptance: Agent output that also arrived via hook → shown once.
Transcript with a system-reminder block → block not visible.
Click Copy on a reply → clipboard holds that reply only.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Agent reply streams in as it is written
cards.user_does: Sends a message and watches.
cards.user_sees: The reply text grows in place before the transcript records it, then is replaced by the final turn without a flicker or a duplicate.
rules: The preview shows only while the agent is working and the preview leads the transcript.
Previews flagged as tool output, empty previews and ones not longer than the last reply are not shown.
acceptance: Send a prompt with a long answer → text appears before the turn completes; on completion exactly one reply remains.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Thoughts, compaction, plans and provider notices
cards.user_does: Reads a turn that included reasoning, a compaction or a plan.
cards.user_sees: Reasoning folded behind a Thought button; a Context compacted separator; a plan shown as formatted text; provider notices with an expandable Details section.
rules: Thought blocks start collapsed.
Notice detail is bounded but never dropped.
Thought rows are the folded reasoning rows shown in the Agents view chat.
acceptance: Turn with reasoning → collapsed Thought button; click → reasoning text.
After a compaction → separator row in the timeline.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Tool calls fold into the agent turn
cards.user_does: Watches the agent read files, run commands, search the web or call MCP tools.
cards.user_sees: One live line naming the current tool and its target; once the turn settles the calls collapse into a compact run with category icons that can be expanded to see each call and result.
rules: Each tool call is paired with its result into one step; an unanswered call stays in flight.
Icons by category: read, edit, shell, MCP (with server name), web, generic.
Input previews are short: file basename, the command, the search term; shell calls drop the tool name in favour of the command.
Failed calls render neutrally rather than alarming red.
Only safe result links are clickable.
Prose and tool blocks in the same message stay separate.
acceptance: Agent runs three commands → one live line while running, one collapsed row after.
Expand → each command and output visible.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: File edits render as diff cards
cards.user_does: Looks at a turn where the agent edited or created files.
cards.user_sees: A coloured diff per file with line numbers, labelled as added, deleted, renamed or edited, with a copy-diff button.
rules: Claude Edit, Write, MultiEdit and Codex apply_patch all normalize to the same card; a multi-file patch gives one card per file.
Long diffs are truncated with a note saying lines are not shown.
Copy diff produces plus/minus prefixed rows.
A rejected edit shows the provider error instead of a diff; notebook edits stay a generic tool row.
Diff-looking text becomes a coloured diff only when it carries hunk headers; a line of dashes is shown as a separator, not a deletion.
acceptance: apply_patch touching two files → two cards.
Rejected edit → error text, no diff.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Subagents show as one roster row
cards.user_does: Watches an agent that spawns subagents.
cards.user_sees: A row saying how many subagents were kicked off, live while they work and switching to a ran-N summary when done, with each child status, elapsed time and token count; a failed child is called out.
rules: Child states: working, idle, completed, failed, stopped, unverifiable; the worst one sets the row verdict.
Children left running by a previous app run settle to unverifiable rather than working forever.
acceptance: Agent spawns 2 subagents → row shows 2 working; when both finish → ran 2 summary.
Restart mid-run → children show unverifiable.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Typing, thinking and working indicators
cards.user_does: Sends a message and waits.
cards.user_sees: A responding indicator right after send, then a working line with elapsed time under the latest user message, then the finished duration.
rules: All elapsed timers share one clock that pauses while the view is hidden.
A stale working state is cleared by a completion or interruption marker; after the user interrupts, working is suppressed.
Claude monitoring mode (waiting on background work) does not count as foreground working.
A working row restored from a previous run is not treated as live.
acceptance: Send → indicator within one frame; reply done → indicator gone and duration shown.
Press Stop → working line disappears.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Chat composer
cards.user_does: Types a message in the box at the bottom of the chat and presses Enter.
cards.user_sees: A box that grows up to about eight lines, sends on Enter, recalls earlier sends with up/down, and keeps an unsent draft per pane.
rules: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; blank sends are ignored and repeats are not added to history twice.
Escape closes an open menu without interrupting the agent.
Typing anywhere in the chat pane redirects keystrokes into the composer; Backspace or Delete focuses it.
IME composition is never cut off or duplicated by Enter.
App-menu Select All and Paste act on the composer.
Drafts are cached per pane with a size bound and survive a PTY reconnect.
When the session has no live terminal the placeholder says to toggle back to reconnect.
The Agents view keeps this composer after the terminal-grid message bar was removed.
acceptance: Type 12 lines → box stops at about 8 and scrolls.
Switch tabs and back → draft still there.
Compose Japanese with IME, press Enter to confirm → nothing sent.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Stop button interrupts the agent
cards.user_does: Clicks Stop while the agent is working.
cards.user_sees: Send turns into Stop during a turn; clicking it interrupts the agent and the working status clears.
rules: A queued delayed send is cancelled before the interrupt goes out.
A double-click on Send cannot land as an accidental Stop.
The Stop control sits above pane chrome so it stays clickable.
In structured chat Stop asks the agent to cancel; the working row stays until the agent confirms the turn ended.
acceptance: Start a long turn, click Stop → agent interrupted, one status row says so.
Double-click Send quickly → one message sent, no interrupt.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Slash commands, skills and file mentions autocomplete
cards.user_does: Types / at the start of a line, @ after a space, or $ in a Codex chat.
cards.user_sees: A menu of commands, skills (grouped by project, personal, built-in, plugin) or files that filters as they type; Tab completes and Enter runs.
rules: Ranking: exact match, then prefix, then fuzzy, then description match.
Claude lists skills under /; Codex uses $ for skills.
When the session reports its own command list, that list replaces the disk scan.
Skill loading shows loading, unavailable and error states; the error has a Retry.
A name that is both a command and a skill is marked as resolved by the agent.
Dismissing the menu for a token keeps it closed for that token.
A finished skill lookup that found nothing is announced as empty, distinct from loading; commands stay selectable while skills load.
Clicking a menu entry chooses it on press, the same as picking it with the keyboard.
acceptance: Type /comp → compact command offered first.
Type @src/ma → matching files listed; Tab inserts the path.
Skill scan fails → error with Retry.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Sending a chat message types it into the agent terminal
cards.user_does: Sends a message from chat to a terminal-backed agent.
cards.user_sees: The message appears at once as a pending bubble and turns into a normal message when the agent records it; a failed send says it was not delivered and to check the terminal.
rules: The TUI input line is cleared, the text pasted (bracketed paste for multi-line), then Enter is sent after a short gap.
Back-to-back sends to the same terminal are queued in order.
Escape and control bytes in the text are neutralised.
Codex picker-style slash commands are typed as keystrokes; other slash commands and skills are pasted.
Pending bubbles match the transcript even when two quick sends were merged into one turn; up to 8 are kept per pane.
A slash command leaves a ran-command marker; a local /clear hides earlier messages.
acceptance: Send two messages within 100 ms → both arrive in order as separate turns.
Send multi-line text → arrives intact as one prompt.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Attach images and files to a chat message
cards.user_does: Pastes an image, drops a file onto the chat, or uses Attach file.
cards.user_sees: Chips with thumbnails above the box, a saving spinner while each one is stored, a click-through full-size preview, and a remove button.
rules: Send is disabled while any attachment is still saving.
Drops only count when made on this pane.
Image paste is refused with a message for agents that cannot take images.
Too many waiting attachments are refused with a message.
Thumbnails retry after the image cache refreshes; a broken one says preview unavailable.
Pasted images get a friendly generic label; picked or dropped files keep their real name.
acceptance: Paste a screenshot → chip with thumbnail; Send disabled until saved.
Drop a file on another pane → not attached here.
cards.decision: H: default build: the live Agents view (area 05) renders this bridge chat for supported sessions even with the experimental flag off, so its default path depends on it.

cards.title: Answer an agent question with a card
cards.user_does: Agent asks a multiple-choice question; the user picks options or types an answer.
cards.user_sees: A card with the question, options (single or multi select), a free-text answer, and for several questions Step N with Next, Skip and Submit.
rules: Answers are delivered to Claude, OpenClaude and Codex as option-number keystrokes.
The card disappears once answered and is dropped by /clear or an interrupt; an identical re-emitted question stays hidden.
If live status lacks the question, it is rebuilt from the transcript.

While an answer is being typed into the agent the card shows Sending… with Cancel and freezes the chosen answer; if the pane changes, sending becomes impossible, or a new question replaces it, the remaining keystrokes are cancelled.
acceptance: Agent asks with 3 options, click 2 → agent receives option 2 and card closes.
Two-question ask → Step 1, Next, Step 2, Submit.

cards.title: Approve or deny a tool permission in chat
cards.user_does: Agent asks permission to run something; the user clicks Allow or Deny.
cards.user_sees: A card asking whether to allow the action, with Allow and Deny, and a Review plan button when the request is to leave plan mode.
rules: A pending approval marks the session as needing attention.

cards.title: Model and effort pickers beside Send
cards.user_does: Picks a model, effort level or fast mode from the controls next to Send.
cards.user_sees: The current model read from the agent, a list of choices with the CLI default named, and effort levels from minimal to max; changes are confirmed or shown as sent but not confirmed.
rules: Claude: the model is read from the TUI header and a switch asks for confirmation; it stays in chat on success.
Codex: changes go through the agent own picker by switching to the terminal.
Toggles whose current value is unknown show On/Off without guessing.
Pickers are disabled while the agent is working.
Choices are saved per agent and seeded into the next launch; models the provider no longer lists are forgotten.
Some options can only be set when the session starts and say so.
In structured chat, typing a bare /model opens the model picker instead of sending text.
A typed /model followed by words that name no known model leaves the shown model unchanged.
A failure reported for an option change that a newer change has replaced is ignored.
acceptance: Pick a different Claude model → confirm → header and picker both show it.
Saved model removed by provider → next launch uses the CLI default.

cards.title: Structured chat sessions run by Kolux itself
cards.user_does: With all three chat switches on, starts a local Claude or Codex session.
cards.user_sees: A chat that Kolux drives directly (no terminal behind it), opened as a workspace tab.
rules: Local hosts only; WSL-only managed Claude accounts are refused.
Only one session may hold a given conversation; a second attempt names the holder.
Codex events and Claude stream events are translated into the same timeline (text, tools, subagents, compaction).
The server refuses structured requests while the flag is off.
A holder that can no longer prove its agent process is alive stops renewing its claim, so the conversation can be taken over.
acceptance: Flags on, launch Codex locally → chat tab with no terminal.
Flags off → structured create refused.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Structured chat never loses or doubles messages
cards.user_does: Chats, quits or crashes the app, and reopens.
cards.user_sees: The full conversation exactly as it was, with no lost or repeated messages.
rules: Each session keeps a durable local journal; sends are idempotent across retries.
A damaged journal is repaired from the provider own history.
Chats saved in the older format are imported once, with a line noting the import.
A journal written by a newer app version is opened read-only and never rewritten.
Items are ordered by their recorded sequence even when clock timestamps run backwards; an item removed by rewind never reappears from a late update.
The repair notice says which stored line could not be read.
The provider echo of a sent message folds into the same bubble instead of adding a second one.
acceptance: Kill the app mid-turn, reopen → every message once, in order.
cards.compat: per-session SQLite journal; legacy chat file import
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Structured chat send status and provider errors
cards.user_does: Sends a message in structured chat when delivery fails or the provider errors.
cards.user_sees: A note that delivery is unconfirmed or the message was not sent, with Retry; provider failures appear as short readable notices with expandable detail.
rules: Provider startup progress and lifecycle frames stay out of the timeline; failures and unknown substantive frames are shown.
The notice leads with the provider own sentence, not the method name.
Streaming fragments of a kind the app does not recognise are appended to the item they belong to, never shown as separate rows.
acceptance: Cut the provider during send → unconfirmed note with Retry; Retry → sent once.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Hand a structured session between chat and the agent terminal
cards.user_does: Moves a structured conversation into the agent own terminal UI and back.
cards.user_sees: The same conversation continues in the other surface; work done in the terminal shows up in chat afterwards; this survives an app restart.
rules: A quit during a stuck handoff does not hang the app.
acceptance: Hand off to TUI, type a prompt, hand back → that turn visible in chat.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Compact, clear and rewind a structured conversation
cards.user_does: Runs /compact or /clear, or rewinds to an earlier message.
cards.user_sees: Compaction shown as a separator; clear starts a fresh record while keeping the old history; rewind returns to the chosen point.
rules: These commands wait until pending work and messages finish.
acceptance: /clear → empty timeline, old conversation still in history.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Background tasks bar with stop controls
cards.user_does: Watches an agent running background commands, monitors, agents or workflows.
cards.user_sees: A status line listing running background tasks by kind, each with its own Stop, and a stop-all fallback when task details are unavailable.
rules: Stopping a background task leaves the foreground turn running and adds no timeline row.
Several task stops are tracked separately; each clears only its own pending state, and a stop result from an older session never clears the current one.
acceptance: Agent starts a background command → listed; Stop → it ends.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Structured sessions report status to the sidebar
cards.user_does: Leaves a structured chat working and looks elsewhere.
cards.user_sees: The sidebar shows working, idle or needs-attention, the model, the running tool and the last message; on completion the chat tab is focused if its workspace is active.
acceptance: Turn finishes while its workspace is active → chat tab focused.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Reopen a structured chat from session history
cards.user_does: Clicks a past structured session in Agent Session History.
cards.user_sees: The chat reopens in its workspace, or a clear message when the chat is gone, the host is too old or unreachable.
rules: One click triggers one activation.
acceptance: Click a deleted session → readable gone message, no blank tab.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Structured session processes are cleaned up
cards.user_does: Closes the chat tab or quits.
cards.user_sees: The provider process ends when nothing shows the chat any more; a running turn is allowed to finish first; quitting does not hang.
rules: An unexpected provider exit is recovered by resuming where possible.
Showing a chat resumes its agent; a chat kept only as background history does not start one.
acceptance: Close the only chat tab → provider process gone within seconds.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Structured chats appear as workspace tabs
cards.user_does: Creates a worktree with a structured agent, or turns the feature off.
cards.user_sees: Each structured chat shows up as a tab in its workspace, even an empty one; turning the feature off removes only those mirrored tabs.
rules: A folder workspace keeps its split and places the chat beside the terminal.
acceptance: New worktree with structured Codex → chat tab present.
Turn feature off → only chat tabs removed.
cards.decision: H: default skip

cards.title: Phone take-over locks chat input
cards.user_does: Takes over a session from the mobile app.
cards.user_sees: The desktop chat composer says input is held by another device and blocks sends.
rules: Take-over is reported per session, never per pane.
acceptance: n/a - decision item

rules: Local attachments are refused for remote sessions that cannot upload.
